meta.description: Reference patterns for augmented coding with AI. Use when discussing AI coding patterns, anti-patterns, obstacles, context management, steering AI, or looking up Lexler's patterns collection.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会参考 Lexler 等人整理的 AI 编码模式、反模式、障碍及上下文管理等知识，在对话中提供相关定义与建议。
howto.when: 当你讨论 AI 编码模式、反模式、障碍、上下文管理、引导 AI，或查询 Lexler 的模式集合时触发。

say.text: 请列出所有上下文管理的模式。
say.note: Claude 会按类别列出模式名称和简要说明。
Claude 会解释该模式的定义和用法。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude references Lexler's collection of AI coding patterns, anti-patterns, obstacles, and context management strategies, providing definitions and suggestions during conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when discussing AI coding patterns, anti-patterns, obstacles, context management, steering AI, or looking up Lexler's patterns collection.

say_en.note: Claude lists pattern names and brief descriptions by category.
